It has more than 10 years of cumulative development accumulated since before the company's founding, and it has strengths in serving large enterprises. entries.d92ed01cf573788a: Under the mission of “Making digital easy, making society rich,” the company is pursuing a multi-product strategy that expands from its flagship product “Yappli” to “Yappli WebX” for web construction, “Yappli MobileOrder” for mobile ordering and “Yappli MiniApp” for LINE mini apps, and aims to realize a digital experience platform (DXP) that centrally manages digital touchpoints across apps, web and LINE.
entries.dc41ab66fd0800cc: This is a single-segment business. Built on its flagship product “Yappli,” it provides solutions such as “Yappli for Marketing,” which supports official corporate apps; “UNITE by Yappli,” which supports internal apps for employees; and “Yappli for Business,” which supports portal apps for business partners. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,056 million, and the share of contracts by number at the end of the fiscal year ended December 2025 was 62% for Yappli for Marketing, 15% for UNITE by Yappli and 7% for Yappli for Business.
